metadata.title: Transkribus Webinar for Beginners (English)
metadata.author: Transkribus
metadata.shortDescription:
Transkribus is the most popular tools for automatic text recognition of historical documents. 

By watching this webinar recording, you will learn how to upload documents to Transkribus, perform automatic text recognition with public AI model and use the document editor to edit the content. You will learn how to enrich your documents with tags, search for specific words and phrases and export the transcriptions in different formats. 

We also take a brief look at how you you can train your own text recognition models that are able to recognise specific fonts in your documents.

🔗 More Useful Links:
Transkribus Web App: app.transkribus.org
Help and Support: help.transkribus.org

#Transkribus #TranskribusTutorial #HowTo #GettingStarted #DigitalArchiving #HistoricalDocuments #DigitalHumanities
